howto.what: 当sandbox执行失败时，Claude会改用写脚本文件并通过系统Python运行代码，从而绕过环境问题。
howto.when: 当execute_code_sandbox连续失败2次或更多，且错误信息不明确或与环境相关时触发。

say.text: 运行这个Python脚本，用文件方式执行。
say.note: Claude会先写文件再通过shell运行。

say.text: 改用直接写文件并执行的方式运行代码。
把这段代码保存成文件，然后用python3执行。

howto.what_en: When sandbox execution fails, Claude switches to writing the script to a file and running it via system Python, bypassing environment issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when execute_code_sandbox fails 2+ times consecutively with unclear or environment-related errors.

say_en.text: Run this Python script using file-based execution.
say_en.note: Claude writes file then runs via shell.

say_en.text: Switch to direct file write and execution.
Save this code as a file and execute with python3.
